## Level 1: quick wins

### INN-001 — Automatic reminders

Send reminders before due dates or appointments on the user's chosen channel.

- **Problem solved:** Patients forget appointments booked weeks in advance.
- **For users:** A timely nudge before the visit.
- **For the business:** Fewer no-shows and empty chair time.
- **Why it fits:** Reminders are the client's own open point (Q-006); dental check-ups are booked weeks ahead.
- **Complexity:** S · **Suggested phase:** PHASE_2 · **Score:** 4.75 (relevance 5, user 5, business 5, effort 4, risk 4)
- **Builds on:** FR-002, Q-006
- **Risks:** Message fatigue; consent rules
- **Technology:** scheduler, email/SMS provider

### INN-002 — Personal calendar sync

Add bookings to Google, Apple or Outlook calendars with updates.

- **Problem solved:** The appointment is not in the patient's own calendar.
- **For users:** One tap adds the visit to their calendar.
- **For the business:** Fewer missed visits at almost no cost.
- **Why it fits:** Bookings are made far ahead; patients keep their own calendars.
- **Complexity:** S · **Suggested phase:** MVP · **Score:** 4.45 (relevance 5, user 5, business 3, effort 4, risk 5)
- **Builds on:** FR-001, FR-002
- **Risks:** Stale events after changes
- **Technology:** iCalendar, calendar APIs

### INN-003 — Core Web Vitals budget

Set and enforce load-time budgets in the build pipeline.

- **Problem solved:** "Load fast" has no shared measure.
- **For users:** A quick page on phones.
- **For the business:** Speed becomes testable and tracked.
- **Why it fits:** Gives NFR-001 a measurable yardstick once the client sets a target.
- **Complexity:** S · **Suggested phase:** PHASE_2 · **Score:** 4.10 (relevance 5, user 3, business 3, effort 5, risk 5)
- **Builds on:** NFR-001, Q-001
- **Risks:** Budgets ignored without ownership
- **Technology:** Lighthouse CI, RUM

### INN-004 — Skeleton loading screens

Show the page layout immediately while data loads to cut perceived wait.

- **Problem solved:** Blank screen while slots load.
- **For users:** The page feels instant.
- **For the business:** Lower drop-off on the booking page.
- **Why it fits:** Availability comes from ClinicDesk and may take a moment to load.
- **Complexity:** S · **Suggested phase:** MVP · **Score:** 3.60 (relevance 4, user 3, business 2, effort 5, risk 5)
- **Builds on:** FR-001, NFR-001
- **Risks:** Hides real slowness from monitoring
- **Technology:** UI components

### INN-005 — Passwordless magic links

Sign in or confirm identity by a one-time link sent by email or SMS.

- **Problem solved:** Patients do not want another password for a twice-yearly visit.
- **For users:** Confirm a booking from their inbox.
- **For the business:** Identity check without account support load.
- **Why it fits:** One of the answers to Q-004 (how patients identify) without passwords.
- **Complexity:** S · **Suggested phase:** PHASE_2 · **Score:** 3.80 (relevance 4, user 4, business 3, effort 4, risk 4)
- **Builds on:** FR-002, Q-004
- **Risks:** Email account takeover
- **Technology:** signed tokens

### INN-006 — One-tap reschedule links

Include a secure link in messages that lets people move their booking.

- **Problem solved:** Changing an appointment needs a phone call.
- **For users:** Move a visit without calling.
- **For the business:** Freed slots can be rebooked.
- **Why it fits:** Relevant only if the client allows online changes (Q-007).

- **Builds on:** FR-002, Q-007
- **Risks:** Link forwarding to others
- **Technology:** signed links

### INN-007 — Funnel analytics

Track where users drop out of key flows such as sign-up or booking.

- **Problem solved:** No evidence of where patients give up.
- **For users:** Indirect: a smoother flow over time.
- **For the business:** Proves the business case of online booking.
- **Why it fits:** Shows whether online booking actually replaces phone calls, the client's stated goal.
- **Complexity:** S · **Suggested phase:** PHASE_2 · **Score:** 3.65 (relevance 4, user 2, business 4, effort 5, risk 4)
- **Builds on:** FR-001, Q-005
- **Risks:** Privacy and consent

### INN-008 — Post-visit reviews

Ask for a rating after a visit or order and route low scores to staff.

- **Problem solved:** Happy patients rarely leave reviews unprompted.
- **For users:** An easy way to give feedback.
- **For the business:** More new-patient bookings.
- **Why it fits:** Local practices win new patients through reviews.

- **Builds on:** FR-002
- **Risks:** Review-gating rules on some platforms

### INN-009 — Bot and abuse protection

Stop automated sign-ups, scraping and fake bookings without CAPTCHAs for most users.

- **Problem solved:** Bots or pranksters can fill the calendar.
- **For users:** Real slots stay available.
- **For the business:** Protects real capacity.
- **Why it fits:** A public booking page without login (Q-004 open) invites fake bookings.
- **Complexity:** S · **Suggested phase:** MVP · **Score:** 3.50 (relevance 4, user 2, business 4, effort 4, risk 4)
- **Builds on:** FR-001
- **Risks:** Blocking real users
- **Technology:** bot detection, rate limiting

## Level 2: product enhancements

### INN-012 — Visual availability calendar

Show free slots across days at a glance with the soonest option highlighted.

- **Problem solved:** Hunting day by day for a free slot.
- **For users:** See the soonest slot at a glance.
- **For the business:** Higher booking completion.
- **Why it fits:** FR-001 is a calendar pick; showing several days at once helps patients find a slot fast.
- **Complexity:** M · **Suggested phase:** PHASE_2 · **Score:** 4.40 (relevance 5, user 5, business 4, effort 3, risk 4)
- **Builds on:** FR-001, IR-001
- **Risks:** Slow on large calendars
- **Technology:** calendar component

### INN-013 — Cached availability with live confirm

Show availability from a fast cache and confirm against the master system at checkout.

- **Problem solved:** Every page view queries ClinicDesk live.
- **For users:** Slots appear quickly.
- **For the business:** Fast pages without overloading ClinicDesk.
- **Why it fits:** ClinicDesk may be slow or rate-limited (RISK-001); a cache with live confirmation protects NFR-001.
- **Complexity:** M · **Suggested phase:** PHASE_2 · **Score:** 3.85 (relevance 5, user 4, business 3, effort 3, risk 3)
- **Builds on:** IR-001, NFR-001, RISK-001
- **Risks:** Shown slot already taken
- **Technology:** cache, background sync

### INN-014 — Graceful degradation

Keep core flows usable when a dependency fails, with clear fallback messages.

- **Problem solved:** A ClinicDesk outage breaks booking with no explanation.
- **For users:** A clear message instead of an error page.
- **For the business:** Bookings fall back to phone gracefully, not lost.
- **Why it fits:** Directly addresses the ERROR_HANDLING gap (Q-008).
- **Complexity:** M · **Suggested phase:** PHASE_2 · **Score:** 3.90 (relevance 5, user 3, business 4, effort 3, risk 4)
- **Builds on:** IR-001, Q-008
- **Risks:** Hidden partial outages
- **Technology:** circuit breaker, fallbacks

### INN-015 — Waitlist with automatic offers

When a slot or item frees up, offer it to the next person on the waitlist.

- **Problem solved:** Cancelled slots stay empty.
- **For users:** Get an earlier slot when one frees up.
- **For the business:** Recovers revenue from cancellations.
- **Why it fits:** Popular slots fill quickly; cancellations otherwise go unused.
- **Complexity:** M · **Suggested phase:** PHASE_2 · **Score:** 3.95 (relevance 4, user 4, business 5, effort 3, risk 3)
- **Builds on:** FR-001, BR-002
- **Risks:** Race conditions on popular slots
- **Technology:** job queue, notifications

- **For the business:** Steady stream of repeat bookings.

## Level 4: future opportunities

### INN-031 — Treatment-plan booking *(bold bet)*

Book every visit of a multi-step treatment plan in one go, sequenced as the dentist planned.

- **Problem solved:** Multi-visit treatments are booked one call at a time.
- **For users:** All visits booked at once.
- **For the business:** Plans completed on time; fewer abandoned treatments.
- **Why it fits:** Extends FR-001 beyond single check-ups; depends on what ClinicDesk exposes.
- **Complexity:** L · **Suggested phase:** FUTURE · **Score:** 3.20 (relevance 3, user 4, business 4, effort 2, risk 2)
- **Builds on:** FR-001, IR-001, BR-001, ClinicDesk treatment-plan data
- **Risks:** Plans change after each visit, BR-001 60-day window may cut a plan short
- **Technology:** ClinicDesk treatment-plan data

<!-- decision:INN-031 -->
**Decision:** PENDING
**Reason:** 
**Decided by:**

<!-- /decision -->

### INN-032 — Family check-up day *(bold bet)*

Book back-to-back check-ups for a whole household in one trip.

- **Problem solved:** Parents make separate calls and trips for each child.
- **For users:** One trip for the whole family.
- **For the business:** Fills adjacent slots; family loyalty.
- **Why it fits:** Families often share a dentist; needs a way to book for dependants (Q-004).

- **Builds on:** FR-001, Q-004, household or dependant records
